name: com.rytify/rytify
title: rytify – The verified memory for AI
description: Verified facts with source, trust level and review history for any topic. Free, no key.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Search verified facts by question or keywords, e.g. "capital of Germany", "SAP CEO", "USDT contract ethereum". Returns the best matching facts with trust level, source and page link.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: All current facts about one subject (company, country, city, crypto asset …) with evidence status. Accepts the slug, name or symbol, e.g. "germany", "SAP", "BTC".

topic.description: Slug, name or symbol of the subject.

tools.name: get_fact
tools.description: One fact by its id, with all versions and the full review history (who checked it, verdict, note, date).

id.description: Fact id (UUID) from ask or get_topic.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Overview of the knowledge areas (galaxies) and the subjects that have facts. Optional filter by galaxy id (e.g. "finance", "geo").

tools.name: submit_knowledge
tools.description: Submit a missing fact or a correction with a public source. It goes into quarantine and is only published after independent review. Do not submit personal data about private individuals, opinions or price information.

statement.description: One factual statement in English (10–1000 characters).

source_url.description: Public source that supports the statement (https://…).

subject.description: Subject the statement is about, e.g. "SAP" or "Berlin".
